compatibility_corrections: Native Git LFS3.8.1 treats git var GIT_ATTR_SYSTEM exiting1 under GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM=1 as fatal; the oracle narrowly substitutes an isolated empty system attributes path for only that exact Git command.
The Rust reader intentionally honors GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM=1 by skipping the system file, and never writes lfs.repositoryformatversion during inspection.

normalization.pattern_order: native exact array order; duplicates retained
normalization.sources: only absolute ROOT/COMMON prefixes replaced; relative and empty source strings preserved

fixture_semantics.files: path or path_hex (native bytes), content or content_hex; optional tracked=true; path placeholders ROOT/COMMON expanded before write
fixture_semantics.config: set local config values after expanding ROOT/COMMON; included config content expands only when expand_placeholders=true
fixture_semantics.setup: optional linked_worktree, remove_working, remove_index, unset_config, conflict_index; all isolated fixture operations
fixture_semantics.layout: Each case owns PARENT/root as ROOT; ordinary COMMON=ROOT/.git. Linked worktree cases use PARENT/main as the primary repository and COMMON=PARENT/main/.git, with linked ROOT directory named root.

coverage_limits: System attributes content is empty by explicit isolation; HOME/XDG default discovery intentionally not exercised.
Platform is Android/Linux native path behavior; Darwin/Windows case folding not covered.

version_notes: Native Local format lookup trims leading/trailing ASCII spaces and LF, but not TAB: space-wrapped 0 and LF-wrapped0 are accepted without rewriting, TAB-wrapped0 is rejected.
Missing, empty, or ASCII-spaces-only values cause native format0 publication; Rust inspection intentionally treats these as logical0 without writing.
Exact string0 is supported; 00, +0, malformed and future versions are rejected. Repeated configuration values use the final scalar.
